caseName: Drivers, Chauffeurs & Helpers Local Union No. 639 v. Yellow Bus Lines, Inc.
caseNameFull: Drivers, Chauffeurs & Helpers Local Union No. 639, Affiliated With International Brotherhood of Teamsters, Chauffeurs, Warehousemen & Helpers of America, AFL-CIO v. Yellow Bus Lines, Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of H. J. Inc. v. Northwestern Bell Telephone Co., ante, p. 229. Justice Stevens would deny certiorari.
